caption: The drawing depicts a single abstract wooden sculpture positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The sculpture itself appears to be made from a light to medium brown wood, with visible wood grain, knots, and darker accent lines that follow the natural contours and cuts in the wood. The form of the sculpture is curvilinear, featuring both rounded, spiral-like shapes and sharper, angular corners, creating a complex, flowing appearance. It has a hollowed area in its upper section and some internal detailing, including a small metallic or light-colored element embedded within. The sculpture is rendered with careful shading and highlights, giving it a three-dimensional look and emphasizing the texture of the wood. In the lower right corner of the image, the name "Gerard Barnett K.C. MO." is written in black ink.
title: Wood Carving
